messages:
dave.eng: heads up — i opened a pin request for runtime v2.3.1 against llama3q variants. want a quick compatibility sanity pass before we lock the pin across prod regions.

deploy-bot: [auto] pin-request created: PR #4821 -> refs/runtime/pin/v2.3.1
 - requested_by: dave.eng
 - target: runtime v2.3.1 pinned for model-family llama3q (all regions)
 - auto-canary: disabled (manual)

sara-qa: flagged one flaky in local CI when running long-context regression suite (context=16k). failing on kv-cache refill:
```
E 2026-03-18 03:12:12.345 kv_cache.cpp:142 refill_mismatch: expected size=8192 got=8190
stack: ...
```
repro steps attached to PR comment.

matt-rl: thanks sara. that looks like a tokenization edge with quantized kernels. can you confirm if it reproduces on cpu-only runtime? if yes, we need a patch; if no, maybe a runtime scheduling mismatch.

sara-qa: quick check: reproduces on both gpu and cpu (same seed). adding more logs.

lina-platform: i'd prefer we only pin in a single region first — canary in eu-west1 for 6h with synthetic traffic (latency + correctness probes). if that looks good we unroll to na + ap. avoids global blast radius.

dave.eng: agreed. proposal: create a regional pin for eu-west1 at 22:00 UTC tonight, 6h canary, metrics: 99p latency, kv-cache error rate, and regression-coverage run. rollback if kv-cache errors > 0.1% or any test failures.

jon-oncall: FYI that window overlaps with planned infra maintenance in eu-west1 at 23:30 UTC (low impact) — i'd rather start at 00:30 UTC to avoid interference.

dave.eng: ok shift to 00:30 UTC start, 6h. infra notified.

ben-release: i'll draft a short release note bullet — "runtime v2.3.1: compatibility pin for llama3q; regional canary in eu-west1; rollback criteria defined". also adding internal changelog with PR link.

matt-rl: probable mitigation: we have a small patch that adjusts KV refill boundary for quantized kernels. i'd like to ship the patch before mass unpin if the canary shows failures. canary -> patch -> re-run canary.

sara-qa: plan accepted. i'll run the full long-context regression during canary and stream logs to #eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: apply pin (runtime v2.3.1) in eu-west1 at 1932121800 UTC. rollback hook configured to unset pin on threshold. action id: a-pt-8291

dave.eng: thanks everyone. summary: start regional canary eu-west1 @ 00:30 UTC, monitor kv-cache error rate + regressions, rollback conditions set, patch ready if needed. will unpin schedule after 48h of clean canary + qa signoff. :white_check_mark:

ben-release: adding follow-up: update release notes + internal ticket linking once canary completes.

jon-oncall: i'll be around for the start and first 2h. ping me in thread if anything spikes.

sara-qa: i'll post results back here once regressed suite finishes (expected +5h).

dave.eng: closing for now — keep thread for any updates.
